summary: At step 25/key <, the Healer points a stethoscope upward from a room tile. C apply.c:use_stethoscope calls engrave.c:cant_reach_floor(u.ux, u.uy, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE), which emits “You can't reach the ceiling.” The saved diagnostic shows that JavaScript skips this call with note_unported("engrave.c cant_reach_floor"), leaving the message out while all RNG entries and cursor positions still match. The actionable source owner is the whole engrave.c:cant_reach_floor function, with the use_stethoscope call wired through its already-present JavaScript helper.

source.branch: Whole-function scope is engrave.c:cant_reach_floor() (217-228), called after a caller establishes that the hero cannot reach. For the assigned path, apply.c:use_stethoscope() has u.dz < 0 and passes up=TRUE, check_pit=TRUE, wand_engraving=FALSE, so ceiling(x,y) supplies “ceiling” and the emitted line is “You can't reach the ceiling.” The complete function also keeps the downward bottom-of-pit versus surface choice and the wand-engraving subject wording.
callers: apply.c:use_stethoscope() (363-364), selected by apply.c:doapply() for STETHOSCOPE (4327-4329). The assigned input uses #wizwish to obtain the stethoscope, applies it, then sends <. In frozen js/apply.js, doapply() dispatches to use_stethoscope(), whose u.dz < 0 arm records note_unported("engrave.c cant_reach_floor") at 2435-2436 instead of calling the existing JS helper. The C helper returns void; use_stethoscope() returns its ECMD result to doapply().

pickup.c:able_to_loot() (2052), called by doloot() (2220) and dotip() (3594). js/pickup.js:able_to_loot() currently refuses the unreachable-floor branch before calling either rider_cant_reach() or cant_reach_floor(); this is a separate incomplete caller path and is not reached by the assigned case.
dig.c:use_pick_axe2() (1317, 1327) calls the helper for two downward-reach refusals; frozen js/dig.js already routes the corresponding arms to js/engrave.js:cant_reach_floor().

engrave.c:u_can_engrave() (512) and engrave.c:doengrave() (1005, 1102) call the helper for swallowed, floor-reach, and wand-engraving refusals; frozen js/engrave.js already routes these downward arms to the helper.
lock.c:forcelock() (703) calls the helper for the floor-reach refusal; frozen js/lock.js already routes that arm to the helper.
dependencies: dungeon.c:ceiling() (1714-1746) returns the description consumed by the up=true message. Its JavaScript counterpart exists at js/dungeon.js:1731, but js/engrave.js does not currently import it.
dungeon.c:surface() supplies the downward non-pit description; js/engrave.js already imports and uses its JavaScript counterpart.
engrave.c:can_reach_floor(FALSE) supplies the Boolean used by the downward check_pit wording; its JavaScript counterpart is already implemented in js/engrave.js.
C pline() emits the message. The JavaScript helper represents this output through its injected pline callback. cant_reach_floor() returns void, and its callers discard the result.

evidence: The saved diagnostic .cache/synthetic-scans/v15/healer-stethoscope-ceiling.json reports 25/26 screens matched, 2737/2737 RNG entries matched, and 26/26 cursors matched. Its only mismatch is the screen at segment 0, step 25, key <; cell row 0, column 0 is C “Y” versus JavaScript space. It records engrave.c cant_reach_floor as unported. The immutable challenges/cases/v15/healer-stethoscope-ceiling.session.json shows the C screen at step 25 beginning “You can't reach the ceiling.”; the input recipe is challenges/cases/v15/healer-stethoscope-ceiling.recipe.session.json.

The source owner is engrave.c:cant_reach_floor() at 217-228. It emits pline("%s can't reach the %s.", ...), using ceiling(x,y) when up is true and otherwise selecting “bottom of the pit” or surface(x,y); wand_engraving selects the message subject. The contextual source path is apply.c:use_stethoscope() at 363-364, reached from apply.c:doapply() at 4327-4329. This resolves the manifest’s caller-level attribution to use_stethoscope into the direct message-producing function.

Frozen js/apply.js:2435-2436 skips the upward call with note_unported("engrave.c cant_reach_floor"). Frozen js/engrave.js:1215-1232 already ports the helper’s downward branch but throws when up=true; the helper currently does not import the existing js/dungeon.js:ceiling(). Port the entire C helper and route the existing use_stethoscope caller through it to cover the assigned mismatch.

The helper is directly called by pickup.c:able_to_loot (2052), dig.c:use_pick_axe2 (1317, 1327), engrave.c:u_can_engrave (512), engrave.c:doengrave (1005, 1102), and lock.c:forcelock (703). The JS dig, engraving, and lock callers already use the helper for their downward branches; pickup.js still refuses its unreachable-floor branch because both rider_cant_reach() and cant_reach_floor() are missing there. That branch is separate from the assigned upward stethoscope path.
